propositions: The byte-total backstop promised in ADR 0005 and the janitor module contract does not exist; _gc_pass reads only free disk space and mtime, never consulting _cache.byte_total or any store-size cap knob.

materialize_tickets populates store entries without calling add_bytes, leaving tickets entries (~620 MiB each) unaccounted in the incremental byte total despite being the dominant consumer in the store.

The snapshot store experiences disk pressure breaches with no size-based reclaim trigger firing, because the free-space threshold is unreachable on large volumes and the promised byte-total backstop is missing.

A new max_bytes tunable with LRU eviction and a configurable cap must be implemented in _gc_pass to restore the promised third reclaim trigger, defaulting to off to preserve existing deployment behavior.
